t: Forge Steel one-handed speed clamp offers efficient and robust clamping for various trade applications. The versatile 6" (150mm) quick clamp allows for swift, single-handed operation, making it ideal for joinery, woodworking, or securing materials during assembly tasks. It features a maximum jaw opening of 150mm and delivers a powerful clamping force of up to 1350N, ensuring a secure hold with minimal effort. The durable steel frame and spindles provide lasting strength, while the ergonomic non-slip handle ensures comfortable and controlled use. The top jaw can be angled to suit different worktops, making this a reliable tool for professional tradespeople across construction and workshop environments.
